description: Blue floor-length structured noble gown with a low square neckline and gold woven embroidered front panels and borders, cream underdress and sleeve lining, decorative round brooches, a narrow gold-patterned belt and a cream-and-blue shoulder wrap resting along the arms. Brown closed leather shoes are visible beneath the hem. Substantial opaque fabric covers the bust, abdomen and pelvis; no headgear, armor or weapons.
